decision: A shortcut refresh now puts extension bindings back after it rebuilds the app bindings
why: The refresh emptied the whole shortcut book, including extension ids, and only the app keybinds were registered again. Starting or leaving a game is a normal state, so the refresh has to keep those bindings.

decision: Registered the single-instance plugin before the notification plugin
why: The Tauri single-instance page says that plugin has to be registered first. On Windows and macOS the notification plugin was registered ahead of it.

decision: Set the app version to 1.0.0 and create the GitHub release with --latest=false before the build uploads
why: GitHub's create-release default marks a new release Latest. tauri-action does not send make_latest, so the first finished platform could replace Electron 2.1.0 as Latest until the later edit.
